feeds.title: Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America Blog
feeds.description: The Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America is the oldest and largest patient advocacy group dedicated to patients with asthma and allergies.

feeds.title: Asthma Australia Blog
feeds.description: Asthma Australia is the recognized national community voice of people with asthma. Keep up to date on the latest news about asthma. Read about interesting, important and current asthma topics on our blog.

feeds.title: Family Allergy Blog
feeds.description: Family Allergy & Asthma is a leading group of board-certified allergists practicing at more than 20 locations throughout Kentucky and Southern Indiana. We recognize that patients come to us because of the limitations placed on them due to their allergic or asthmatic conditions. It is our goal to remove these limitations, to the greatest possible extent, and to give patients their lives back.

feeds.title: Allergy & Asthma Network
feeds.description: Allergy & Asthma Network is the leading nonprofit whose mission is to end needless death and suffering due to allergies, asthma and related conditions through outreach, education, advocacy and research. Read The latest news and articles from Allergy & Asthma Network.

feeds.title: Breathinstephen
feeds.description: To help cope with his severe asthma, Stephen Gaudet turned to exercise, developing his own pulmonary rehab program to help maintain what was left of his lung function. Big on aerobic exercise, he frequently takes part in race walking and endurance walking tournaments, chronicling his experiences, discussing his treatment decisions, and sharing the nuances of living with asthma in general.

feeds.title: Colorado Allergy & Asthma Centers Blog
feeds.description: Colorado Allergy and Asthma® Clinic opened in 1972, with just three doctors. We've grown steadily over time, developed our practice, and added locations to better serve our patients. Today, we are proud to have a team of 13 outstanding physicians at 12 locations spanning from Castle Rock to Fort Collins, and we are honored to serve over 53,000 patients. Read our blog, where you'll find information about allergies, asthma, treatments, and much more.

feeds.title: My Life as an Asthma Mom
feeds.description: Written by a mom with allergies and asthma. Caring for her 3 children who have allergies and asthma and offering advice on how to avoid the pitfalls. I'm also a Certified Asthma Educator AE-C!

feeds.title: Asthma Center
feeds.description: Allergy and Asthma blog with allergy news for Philadelphia, South Jersey by top allergists. Delaware Valley's official pollen, ragweed and mold counts.

feeds.title: ANONYMOUS-ASTHMA
feeds.description: There is no name.... what do you call the uncontrollable which doesn't fit the textbook. Sharing my life of living with difficult asthma, triumphs, failures and all that goes with it! This blog is for awareness of asthma but also to reflect on how I cope with my asthma and living a normal life and dealing with difficult situations. Blog by Olivia Fulton.

feeds.title: Aluna Blog
feeds.description: Aluna is your source for finding answers to questions you have about lung health and asthma management. We provide information and resources for parents, doctors, and asthma sufferers wanting to take control of their health.

feeds.title: The Asthma Cures
feeds.description: Covers articles to help cure asthma, and other home remedies.

feeds.title: Allergy Notes - Dr. Dimov
feeds.description: Allergy, Asthma and Immunology News Updated Daily by Board-certified Allergists and Assistant Professors at University of Chicago and NSU.

feeds.title: asth.ma
feeds.description: Ann Wu is a doctor, mother, and asthma researcher at Harvard Medical School who uses this blog to share information about treatments, research, and more. She breaks down complex medical studies so that their findings are more digestible for other parents, puts a spotlight on the biggest gaps in research and overall medical knowledge pertaining to asthma, and shares helpful and informative links.

feeds.title: Regency Medical Centre » Asthma
feeds.description: Regency Medical Centre is an innovative and dependable Multi Speciality Hospital in Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania, equipped with state-of-the-art technology. The objective of Regency Medical Center is to ensure that each and every citizen of Tanzania can get affordable medical assistance. Follow this blog feed to know more about asthma.

feeds.title: RAYCOP
feeds.description: A blog focused around allergies, allergens & how RAYCOP UV HEPA filtration vacuum cleaners help you beat them and inhale fresh and clean air around you.
